titleEn: Longest Substring Of All Vowels in Order
title: 所有元音按顺序排布的最长子字符串
summary: 寻找最长连续子串，使其只含元音且按 a、e、i、o、u 非递减排列，并且五种元音都至少出现一次。
insight: 扫描当前非递减元音段；字符下降时从当前位置重启。字符严格变化时增加不同元音数，达到五种后用当前段长度更新答案。

solutions.title: 有序元音段扫描
solutions.idea: 在线维护当前非递减段起点与不同字符数。
steps: i 从一：若 word[i]<word[i-1]，start=i、distinct=1；否则若字符变化 distinct++

code.java: class Solution { public int longestBeautifulSubstring(String word){int start=0,distinct=1,answer=0;for(int i=1;i<word.length();i++){if(word.charAt(i)<word.charAt(i-1)){start=i;distinct=1;}else if(word.charAt(i)>word.charAt(i-1))distinct++;if(distinct==5)answer=Math.max(answer,i-start+1);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun longestBeautifulSubstring(word:String):Int{var start=0;var distinct=1;var answer=0;for(i in 1 until word.length){if(word[i]<word[i-1]){start=i;distinct=1}else if(word[i]>word[i-1])distinct++;if(distinct==5)answer=maxOf(answer,i-start+1)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int longestBeautifulSubstring(string word){int start=0,distinct=1,answer=0;for(int i=1;i<(int)word.size();++i){if(word[i]<word[i-1]){start=i;distinct=1;}else if(word[i]>word[i-1])++distinct;if(distinct==5)answer=max(answer,i-start+1);}return answer;} };
